requirements.acceptance: The generated graph and its source-scope digest determine one reproducible sequence. Negative: Select the old mixed plan, omit a backend producer, or reclassify a chart renderer as backend: reject.
requirements.text: One canonical authority and backend-first completion graph: Only CANONICAL_AUTHORITY.json selects the active master and generated plan. Historical plans are immutable lineage, never runnable implementation authority. All backend and backend-verification units precede BG-001; every new UX/frontend unit depends on the same BG-001 scope.

requirements.acceptance: Every changed implementation group and historical feature has a source-to-backend-to-screen-to-test chain. Negative: Delete a PR-only action, discard a complete candidate branch without dispositions, or report an inferred effect as observed: reject.
requirements.text: Source-preserving implementation admission: Keep exact source paths, commit and content hashes, test evidence, feature obligations and ADOPT/ADAPT/REFERENCE dispositions. Retain all source candidates until their replacement or rejection is explicitly justified; never accept a reviewed module solely because its parent branch has passing CI.

requirements.acceptance: A pending fill with a rejected venue stop triggers the same admitted recovery as an immediate fill and updates risk and Attention. Negative: Inject rejected/unknown protection at delayed or partial fill; a local rule alone must not yield CONFIRMED or permit additional risk.
requirements.text: Protection parity for immediate and pending fills: Route FILLED and PARTIAL receipts from all origins through one protection reconciler. Track REQUESTED, CONFIRMED, UNKNOWN and MISSING separately. Never register an intended local stop as proof of a venue stop. Apply the currently admitted immediate flatten/halt response unless an independently qualified owner-admitted bounded re-read/reattach policy replaces it; record timeout and unknown close outcomes.

requirements.acceptance: At-touch and gapped quote fixtures preserve the limit in both directions; explicit capped-market fixtures preserve their separate slippage envelope. Negative: The current 1.10000 limit with 0.00010 spread and 0.00002 slippage must never fill a BUY at 1.10007 or a SELL at 1.09993.
requirements.text: Limit-price invariants and explicit order semantics: BUY LIMIT fills at or below its limit and SELL LIMIT at or above it, using the relevant executable quote and eligible event time. An at-touch order that is not executable within its limit rests or is refused. A capped-market order is a distinct intent/template with its own signed semantics; logging a LIMIT-to-MARKET substitution does not make it authorized. Unknown venue capabilities deny the operation.

requirements.acceptance: A four-hour STOP_ENTRY cannot remain eligible for 24 hours; PRE_BLACKOUT/POST_BLACKOUT moves eligible pending orders into cancellation workflow. Negative: Drop max_wait, substitute a later expiry, or fill an ineligible resting order without reconciliation/Attention: fail.
requirements.text: Pending-order expiry and event-policy propagation: Bind policy digest, order expiry, mandate validity, market-session constraints and cancel-on-event rules into the immutable execution command and pending supervisor. Effective expiry is the earliest applicable allowed deadline; absent or stale policy is not a 24-hour default. Clock and source revisions remain explicit.

requirements.acceptance: EXPIRED, CANCELLED and REJECTED unfilled orders disappear from working-order totals but remain in historical records; partial positions retain actual exposure. Negative: A stale ACCEPTED receipt after terminal readback must not resurrect Working; duplicate fill/cancel events must not double-count.
requirements.text: Terminal order read models and monotonic lifecycle reduction: Project orders from the complete canonical lifecycle, ordered and deduplicated by broker event/sequence and reconciliation revision. PLACED is the code state and Working the label. Separate unfilled terminal orders from residual exposure after partial fills. Conflicting events become reconciliation-required, not last-arrival optimism.

requirements.acceptance: FX, JPY, metals and alternative broker digit fixtures produce correct bounds from actual contract metadata and remain within the approved loss envelope. Negative: Unknown digits, stale contract revision, a rounded stop beyond risk or below broker distance, or treating an old absolute cap as a new fraction: refuse.
requirements.text: Executable quantisation before authority and metadata-based slippage: Use provider SymbolContract tick size, point size, digits, units, min/freeze stops and revision to build the executable preview first. Validate stop side and distance, risk in account currency and lot step on exact decimals. Risk and owner approval bind those executable values. Version relative-price versus absolute-price versus points units; recalculate and reapprove if changed. Preserve the no-widening invariant but do not hide a broker-invalid too-close stop.

requirements.acceptance: New-row work scales with appended records while honest replay matches full verification in SQLite and Postgres. Negative: Tamper, truncate, fork, roll back, replace a ledger or supply a stale checkpoint: fail closed and force full verification. The research always-True monkeypatch is forbidden.
requirements.text: Incremental ledger verification with explicit integrity envelope: Retain verified incremental anchors and periodic full checks; bind ledger identity, row sequence/count, chain root, source epoch and checkpoint lifetime. Full verification is required on first use, detected change, failed incremental proof and the admitted maximum interval. Document the distinction between immediate detection of new-row/rechain/deletion faults and delayed detection of in-place historical edits; stronger write protection or integrity monitoring may reduce that window.

requirements.acceptance: Restart replays the same locks; independent manual/autonomous cooldown tests coexist with shared all-origin hard-limit tests. Negative: A restart resets losses, a default silently changes a signed policy, a manual entry bypasses total-account drawdown, or an owner reset erases economic loss: reject.
requirements.text: Signed lockout policy activation and persistent all-origin risk: Retain 24-hour cooldown, 0.5 probation and suspension after more than two cooldowns in seven days as the accepted values, not live authority. Bind all fields, scope rules and policy revision into the signed mandate before activating a changed production policy. Keep autonomous strategy/account and owner.manual cooldown scopes as recorded by OD-38; always apply economic all-origin account drawdown, margin, exposure and protection ceilings. Persist reset events, loss history, economic peaks and day/week baselines.

requirements.acceptance: Known-profit/loss fixtures match analytically specified results and the actual execution adapters' admitted semantics. Negative: Disabling controls, altering quote units or a permissive fill model without a distinct experiment identity invalidates promotion evidence.
requirements.text: Qualified chronological evaluator before automated strategy development: Establish one qualified evaluator version before candidate selection uses it. Separate isolation experiments from deployment-faithful evaluation; both declare code, data, controls, costs and random seeds. An independent fixture oracle checks event eligibility, bid/ask, limit/stop/expiry, partial fills, costs, cash flows and restart/risk controls.

requirements.acceptance: Replay of each named chronological fold yields the same pre-cutoff decisions and verified split provenance. Negative: Future-only perturbation changes past decisions, a scaler sees the holdout, or window count is only the count of calendar years: fail.
requirements.text: Leakage-proof chronology and genuine walk-forward records: Persist train/validation/test intervals, strategy frozen-at time, embargo/purge rules, label horizons, warmup-only data and candidate selection cutoffs. Mutating only unavailable future data must leave prior features and decisions unchanged. A deliberately leaking implementation must fail. Yearly summaries remain descriptive, not walk-forward windows; a 2025 label does not by itself create untouched out-of-sample evidence.

requirements.acceptance: From permitted raw inputs, a second run reproduces the same bars, sessions, costs and outcomes. Negative: Bid is silently treated as midpoint, fixed EST becomes DST-local time, a bar is used before close or a mirror is unpinned: reject qualifying use.
requirements.text: Immutable dataset, quote, calendar and cost provenance: Use a DatasetManifest with exact hashes, provider/mirror revision, permitted-use state, timezone/DST handling, bid/ask/mid semantics, bar timestamp conventions, missing/duplicate intervals and transformation code. Preserve full spread, commissions, financing, slippage, liquidity and FX assumptions per venue and period. A source access/usage gap is never hidden by calling fixtures live.

requirements.acceptance: Each reported metric identifies the population, formula/version, trial set, uncertainty and selection scope. Negative: A pooled PBO is relabeled pair-specific, losers disappear from trial count, or repeated holdout tuning is called independent: fail promotion.
requirements.text: Complete trial ledger and honest statistical interpretation: Record every tried configuration, failure, search budget, selection rule, effective trial treatment, untouched holdout and actual cost model. Label DSR and PBO according to their statistical meaning and calculation cohort, not chance of skill or trade-win probability. Economic admission is per exact dataset/evaluator/model/policy scope, separate from software completion.

requirements.acceptance: A weekly run is idempotent by period/strategy/dataset/evaluator; results reproduce and a candidate reaches only permitted next states. Negative: A model edits protected execution/risk paths, repeated runs duplicate studies, a failed candidate becomes a promotion opportunity, or an unsigned candidate trades live: refuse.
requirements.text: Governed weekly strategy-development lifecycle: One standing, scoped research grant may schedule offline diagnostics, generate candidate versions and evaluate them; it cannot alter live policy. Loss clusters generate hypotheses evaluated against winners, exposure/opportunity frequency and market regimes. Separate distribution drift from predictive deterioration. Preserve parents and all trials. Passing candidates appear as promotion proposals; failures and system faults stay inspectable. Live promotion uses a fresh exact artifact/policy-bound owner decision and stage evidence; automatic demotion only within an admitted reduce-risk policy.

requirements.acceptance: A pre-signed ticket arms only in its declared readiness envelope and can claim the nonce once. Negative: Empty proof, arbitrary real proof label, proof for another account/event, re-signed weakened allowlist or concurrent duplicate use: reject.
requirements.text: Typed proof sufficiency and news arming readiness: Keep duplicate rejection, exact transition allowlists and approval/submission/readback dominators. Extend proposed news SIGNED→ARMED with valid owner grant, pre-arm window, account/mandate/policy revisions, healthy required sources and unused nonce. Execution still needs the event's two-source agreement, current quote/risk and atomic nonce claim. Validate proof issuer, subject, digest, freshness and revocation at runtime; definitions do not execute checks.

requirements.acceptance: Deposit/withdrawal/credit/fee and pending-order interleavings reconcile exact money, positions and risk without false P&L. Negative: Redirect settles money, a timeout resubmits, deleting restores secrets, unclassified flow silently improves risk capital, or a withdrawal bypasses concurrent reservations: reject.
requirements.text: Funding and account deletion concurrency with economic accounting: Separate local unlink, archive, credential rotation and remote closure. Use durable idempotent funding intents, beneficiary/quote-bound approval, reserved outgoing collateral, debit/credit leg reconciliation and compensating reversals. Cash-flow-adjusted returns use a versioned unitization or equivalent tested convention; preserve economic drawdown separately from authorized risk resets. Fresh atomic checks prevent unlink/deletion or withdrawal racing a fill/unknown transfer.

requirements.acceptance: Every mapped owner action and new capability has one traceable caller and appropriate screen/sheet/dialog outcome. Negative: A visually complete screen lacks its source or any backend is unfinished; BG-001 and frontend entry refuse.
requirements.text: Complete backend consumer catalogue before native UX: Publish a revisioned capability/action/event/error/provenance catalogue for every admitted backend feature. Each operation declares read/write authority, availability, precision, stale semantics, approval, cancellation and receipt deep links. The full catalogue, not a fixed five-flow demo, drives information architecture and all-surface contracts after BG-001.

requirements.acceptance: Every one of the 90 forecast requirements maps to an active unit and test; all required child backend receipts reach BG-001. Negative: A child F15/BG independently opens UI, Qlib or Freqtrade sends a live order, or a unavailable provider is labeled healthy: reject.
requirements.text: Single forecasting integration without a second trading engine: Fold all 48 forecast-source packet obligations into the one parent graph, preserving their IDs through explicit aliases. Implement Qlib/LightGBM, NeuralForecast and admitted Freqtrade/FreqAI-derived lifecycle capabilities, prediction-market information and replay research labs. Retain VATI as the sole risk and order authority. No-procurement scope is preserved; live event-contract orders are not introduced.

requirements.acceptance: The complete pack rebuilds identically and invalid evidence cannot change readiness. Negative: Edit input and matching local hash, delete a receipt, swap source revision, self-declare signature_valid, or reuse device evidence across builds: block readiness.
requirements.text: Source-bound evidence promotion and non-self-issued certificates: Receipt eligibility binds exact source, configuration, test command, data, device/provider scope, issuer authority, freshness and failure evidence. Structural checks only validate the specification. F15, BG-001 and release gates require independently verified signed receipts through the qualified authority; no offline document tool can issue them. Guard proof, requirement locks and manifests remain PREPARED until owner approval.

requirements.acceptance: Full-scope native dark/light goldens, action reachability and physical S24 cases match the same backend catalogue revision. Negative: Only showcase flows pass, legacy UI leaks into new modules, safety states are hidden for aesthetics, or unknown data looks live: reject final qualification.
requirements.text: Full tactile design and feature preservation across every context: After BG-001, customize the accepted tactile spatial material/lighting/typography to each screen purpose. Preserve every context and 349 historical action entries, add strategy/forecast/execution-state views where needed, and retain accessible alternatives. A graph, chart workstation, funding confirmation and small orb hub share design DNA, not one repeated generic card layout.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-001-P; VAN-ML-AT-001-N
requirements.text: Preserve inherited scope and branch improvements: Retain every mapped parent action and source-backed capability; no competing trading stack.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-002-P; VAN-ML-AT-002-N
requirements.text: Admit complete targets and market scope: Resolve target units, cohorts, providers, required plugins, consumers and budget before implementation.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-003-P; VAN-ML-AT-003-N
requirements.text: Respect independent F15 and backend-first authority: No code-bearing child may start before current parent F15 and source admission; frontend also requires global BG.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-004-P; VAN-ML-AT-004-N
requirements.text: Lock tested libraries and isolate computation: Produce reproducible environment manifests and actual VM compatibility evidence without loading training stacks in T0.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-005-P; VAN-ML-AT-005-N
requirements.text: Point-in-time source availability: Every feature source has event and availability timestamps, revision identity and provenance quality.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-006-P; VAN-ML-AT-006-N
requirements.text: Survivorship and instrument identity: Universe and contract membership are as-of; canonical identity includes venue and contract, not ticker alone.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-007-P; VAN-ML-AT-007-N
requirements.text: Calendar and bar completeness: Use closed observed bars and per-market session/business-time horizons with gap policy.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-008-P; VAN-ML-AT-008-N
requirements.text: Single feature definition and offline-online parity: Reuse the VAN feature owner, version transformations and materialize Feast views without alternate T0 authority.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-009-P; VAN-ML-AT-009-N
requirements.text: Train-only transforms and aligned row masks: Fit scalers, PCA, feature selection and outlier transforms only inside training boundaries; preserve X/y/weight alignment.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-010-P; VAN-ML-AT-010-N
requirements.text: Controlled feature expansion: Lag, timeframe, peer and calendar features use an admitted DAG and measured feature budget.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-011-P; VAN-ML-AT-011-N
requirements.text: Target maturity and event semantics: Every label records interval, available_at, cost treatment, censoring and target version.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-012-P; VAN-ML-AT-012-N
requirements.text: Separate facts, practice and counterfactuals: Do not mix actual fills, paper/practice, inferred outcomes and synthetic fixtures in promotion statistics.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-013-P; VAN-ML-AT-013-N
requirements.text: Return, ranking, volatility and cost targets: Provide all requested target families with correct domain and units; no binary-option payoff guessed as linear return.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-014-P; VAN-ML-AT-014-N
requirements.text: Purged chronological validation: Purge overlapping label intervals across training/validation/calibration/test; synchronize cohort cutoffs.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-015-P; VAN-ML-AT-015-N
requirements.text: Bias and warmup diagnostics: Build native lookahead/prefix and indicator-recursion checks; poison tests must demonstrate sensitivity.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-016-P; VAN-ML-AT-016-N
requirements.text: Immutable final holdout and trial census: Pre-register holdout access and count architectures/features/horizons/calibrators tried, including failures.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-017-P; VAN-ML-AT-017-N
requirements.text: Direction-neutral intrabar uncertainty: Use observed subbars/ticks or declared feasible market scenarios; never claim a long-only path is conservative for all sides.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-018-P; VAN-ML-AT-018-N
requirements.text: Economic cost and valuation accounting: Debit monetary costs once and use realizable prices, latency, partial fills and post-liquidation equity.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-019-P; VAN-ML-AT-019-N
requirements.text: Flow-adjusted and open-position risk metrics: Preserve cash-flow-neutral performance and current collateral/MTM drawdown as separate measurements.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-020-P; VAN-ML-AT-020-N
requirements.text: Account-wide research-live parity: Use the real account coordinator and policy interfaces with isolated execution and reservation state.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-021-P; VAN-ML-AT-021-N
requirements.text: Nonvacuous deterministic evidence: Determinism concerns specified events/decisions, not just final trade count or zero-checked replay.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-022-P; VAN-ML-AT-022-N
requirements.text: Qlib model boundary and processor configuration: Use custom VAN data handlers; configure processor fitting, DK_L/DK_I and Recorder explicitly; no Qlib execution runtime.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-023-P; VAN-ML-AT-023-N
requirements.text: LightGBM regression production adapter: Implement per-target/horizon expected-return/net-edge models and native export with exact transform manifest.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-024-P; VAN-ML-AT-024-N
requirements.text: Calibratable setup classification: Implement binary target models with defined population and raw-probability semantics before separate calibration.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-025-P; VAN-ML-AT-025-N
requirements.text: Quantile adapter completeness: Implement separate quantile/horizon objectives outside unsupported stock Qlib loss API.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-026-P; VAN-ML-AT-026-N
requirements.text: Grouped ranking correctness: Train ranking with cutoff/universe query groups and appropriate nonnegative relevance coding; report ordinal scores.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-027-P; VAN-ML-AT-027-N
requirements.text: Meaningful baseline and challenger comparisons: Implement XGBoost and simple/statistical incumbents against identical targets and calendars.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-028-P; VAN-ML-AT-028-N
requirements.text: NeuralForecast shared data contract: Map unique_id/ds/y and exogenous inputs with immutable cutoffs and fold-scoped scalers.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-029-P; VAN-ML-AT-029-N
requirements.text: N-HiTS complete research integration: Implement real NHITS training, multi-horizon inference, model persistence and shared provenance.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-030-P; VAN-ML-AT-030-N
requirements.text: N-BEATSx contextual and interpretability integration: Implement supported exogenous inputs and optional native decomposition with noncausal explanations.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-031-P; VAN-ML-AT-031-N
requirements.text: DeepAR distribution and path integration: Implement domain-valid distributions and retained individual temporal samples with seeds.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-032-P; VAN-ML-AT-032-N
requirements.text: Complete challenger plugin interfaces: Implement TFT, PatchTST and iTransformer research plugins, gated by verified per-model capability matrix.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-033-P; VAN-ML-AT-033-N
requirements.text: Reuse existing conformal ownership: Extend existing vati.risk.conformal and source-bound calibration producer; no independent sizing permission.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-034-P; VAN-ML-AT-034-N
requirements.text: Honest probability and interval calibration: Validate disjoint calibration, empirical coverage and adequacy; label marginal/conditional limitations.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-035-P; VAN-ML-AT-035-N
requirements.text: Calibration lineage and tail semantics: Bind calibration to exact model/transform/target; avoid unsupported joint-tail, stop-touch and transformed-mean claims.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-036-P; VAN-ML-AT-036-N
requirements.text: One bounded optimization control: Use one Optuna/trial budget across Qlib/NF; all optimization only creates candidates.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-037-P; VAN-ML-AT-037-N
requirements.text: Safe artifact and supply-chain boundary: Use native LightGBM and vetted safe neural formats; allowlisted loaders verify immutable bytes.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-038-P; VAN-ML-AT-038-N
requirements.text: Registry is not authority: MLflow aliases and experiment status never grant forecast influence or strategy promotion.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-039-P; VAN-ML-AT-039-N
requirements.text: Durable adaptive retraining: Implement per-scope jobs, cadence/drift triggers, leases, retries, checkpoints and safe cancellation.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-040-P; VAN-ML-AT-040-N
requirements.text: Prevent schedule and resource starvation: Coalesce obsolete retrains with explicit receipts, bound queue/threads and protect serving/T0 capacity.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-041-P; VAN-ML-AT-041-N
requirements.text: Typed forecast service and complete provenance: Emit ForecastPacket or abstention with scope, cutoffs, target, model, transformation and source evidence.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-042-P; VAN-ML-AT-042-N
requirements.text: Independent freshness and OOD checks: Validate model age, data age, calibration age and novelty as separate dimensions.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-043-P; VAN-ML-AT-043-N
requirements.text: Nonblocking inference and immutable cache: Preload admitted artifacts and cache by all material identities; T0 never awaits training/registry/network.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-044-P; VAN-ML-AT-044-N
requirements.text: OOF-only forecast fusion and redundancy control: Learn combination only from out-of-fold predictions and track shared information across models.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-045-P; VAN-ML-AT-045-N
requirements.text: Preserve trading and financial authority: Models propose evidence only; only existing RiskAuthority sizes and ExecutionRouter sends orders.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-046-P; VAN-ML-AT-046-N
requirements.text: Independent edge evidence and mode integration: Supply real economic-evidence producer and signed scope binding for Normal/Risky/Aggressive policy use.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-047-P; VAN-ML-AT-047-N
requirements.text: Complementary suppression without duplicate risk governor: Implement per-instrument/strategy cooldown and loss/profit protections through existing risk controls.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-048-P; VAN-ML-AT-048-N
requirements.text: Outcome attribution and scientific data moat: Join all eligible candidates and model outputs to observed decisions/outcomes and label unobserved counterfactuals.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-049-P; VAN-ML-AT-049-N
requirements.text: Privacy and correction propagation: Respect entitlements/consent; invalidate downstream datasets/models when affected source is corrected/revoked.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-050-P; VAN-ML-AT-050-N
requirements.text: Every capability has a genuine caller and readback: Publish complete catalog/actions/error states and actual gateway operations without new frontend implementation.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-051-P; VAN-ML-AT-051-N
requirements.text: Truthful confidence and explanation surfaces: Keep raw rank/rule score, calibrated event probability, intervals and economic evidence distinct.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-052-P; VAN-ML-AT-052-N
requirements.text: Authorized VM deployment and recovery: Use qualified Global DIAL/Zuul execution routes, exact source, resource admission and tested isolation.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-053-P; VAN-ML-AT-053-N
requirements.text: Bounded capacity and observability: Measure real CPU/memory/latency/disk and keep risk/protection independent of research load.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-054-P; VAN-ML-AT-054-N
requirements.text: Actual statistical and economic evaluation: Use matched OOS forecasts, costs, intervals, DSR/PBO where applicable and pre-registered uncertainty analysis.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-055-P; VAN-ML-AT-055-N
requirements.text: Real shadow pipeline and full rejection path: Exercise the real pipeline in shadow/sandbox and preserve prospective timestamped outcomes.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-056-P; VAN-ML-AT-056-N
requirements.text: Independent complete additive backend closure: All mandatory backend engineering must have real source/service/caller/failure evidence.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-057-P; VAN-ML-AT-057-N
requirements.text: Global backend barrier and contract renewal: Integrate with all parent backend/BQ obligations; renew BG before any new UX/frontend.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-058-P; VAN-ML-AT-058-N
requirements.text: Complete post-backend UI integration: Apply every forecast capability/state/action in appropriate existing native screen families after BG.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-059-P; VAN-ML-AT-059-N
requirements.text: Physical and whole-product final acceptance: Actual S24 and signed app use the qualified backend and preserve all inherited actions.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-060-P; VAN-ML-AT-060-N
requirements.text: Separate software release from live-model promotion: Release software by parent policy; live influence requires independent model/strategy/account admission and owner authority.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-061-P; VAN-ML-AT-061-N
requirements.text: Separate deployment, source access and procurement: Record Netcup/Oracle execution profiles; no licence procurement or external spending in this phase; no inference that VM location establishes operator eligibility.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-062-P; VAN-ML-AT-062-N
requirements.text: Non-blocking no-procurement development path: Provide implemented fixture/replay and provider-adapter paths; source-use status is scoped; absent purchased licence cannot block ordinary specification, coding or fixture validation.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-063-P; VAN-ML-AT-063-N
requirements.text: Versioned bounded read-only adapters: Implement allowlisted market-data REST and optional read-only streaming with pinned contract revisions, timeouts, rate budgets and cursor handling; no order/account mutations.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-064-P; VAN-ML-AT-064-N
requirements.text: Point-in-time archive and live completeness: Store publication/receive/availability clocks and per-record historical cutoffs; dedupe and reconcile archive handoffs without inventing past receipt times.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-065-P; VAN-ML-AT-065-N
requirements.text: Exact bid and ask conversion: Parse fixed-point price/quantity strings and derive YES asks from NO bids and vice versa; retain source book and executable depth.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-066-P; VAN-ML-AT-066-N
requirements.text: Stream gap and sequence recovery: Apply sequence-aware deltas idempotently; gaps, negative resulting depth or duplicate mismatches force INVALID until full resynchronization.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-067-P; VAN-ML-AT-067-N
requirements.text: Canonical event and proposition identity: Bind thresholds/comparators, units, timezones, official source/vintage and rules digest; distinguish exact, complement, overlapping and non-equivalent contracts.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-068-P; VAN-ML-AT-068-N
requirements.text: Resolution and cash settlement are separate: Track occurrence, release, close, provisional outcome, dispute/cancel and final settlement separately; corrections create versions.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-069-P; VAN-ML-AT-069-N
requirements.text: Maturity-aware contract continuity: Key probability changes by event/proposition/horizon and explicit roll rule; missing successor contracts produce missing features.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-070-P; VAN-ML-AT-070-N
requirements.text: Coherent distributions without fabricated tails: Differentiate mutually exclusive bins from overlapping thresholds; monotonicity, mass, open-tail and adjustment policies are explicit.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-071-P; VAN-ML-AT-071-N
requirements.text: Quality-aware market-implied estimates: Track estimator type, depth, spread, age, activity and rule coherence separately from calibration; empty books produce missing observations.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-072-P; VAN-ML-AT-072-N
requirements.text: Freeze expectations before official information: Link each surprise to the last genuinely available pre-release snapshot and official release vintage; no future availability.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-073-P; VAN-ML-AT-073-N
requirements.text: Two-source agreement is not independence: Preserve parent Kalshi/Polymarket liquidity/agreement rules for armed expectations; matching horizons and semantic relation required; no independent-evidence multiplication.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-074-P; VAN-ML-AT-074-N
requirements.text: Event-grouped calibration and adequate evidence: Calibrate by declared event family/horizon/cohort with matured labels; group dependent snapshots/contracts and report effective event counts and uncertainty.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-075-P; VAN-ML-AT-075-N
requirements.text: Preserve probability meaning: Market-implied estimate, calibrated physical-event probability, asset outcome probability and rank score are distinct types and fields.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-076-P; VAN-ML-AT-076-N
requirements.text: Correct Qlib and neural event-feature adapters: Feed as-of event features to existing Qlib/LightGBM tasks and supported NeuralForecast historical covariates; future calendar use is versioned and not future probabilities.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-077-P; VAN-ML-AT-077-N
requirements.text: Conditional asset response and incremental information: Estimate event-to-instrument outcomes under context, timing and horizon; compare against conventional market/news/calendar features and use OOF fusion.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-078-P; VAN-ML-AT-078-N
requirements.text: Preserve D1–D7 and manual ownership: External information affects entries/ranking/lifecycle only through inherited rules; D7 is required for news-generated added risk; existing risk authority sizes.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-079-P; VAN-ML-AT-079-N
requirements.text: Net executable binary-contract value: For held-to-settlement use expected payout minus actual entry costs/fees/lockup; for early exit use executable exit distribution; market price is not independent edge.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-080-P; VAN-ML-AT-080-N
requirements.text: Full event-loss and portfolio stress: Model maximum binary outlay, related event exposures and uncertain probabilities; Kelly-style analysis remains a bounded sandbox proposal, never sizing authority.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-081-P; VAN-ML-AT-081-N
requirements.text: Exact fees and complete settlement accounting: Use revision/series/account-specific fee rules, per-fill precision/accumulator, cash reservations and all relevant settlement/conversion costs.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-082-P; VAN-ML-AT-082-N
requirements.text: Queue-aware feasible event execution: Model real observation/decision/order latency, depth, partial fills, queue uncertainty and cancel races; sparse data cannot prove maker profitability.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-083-P; VAN-ML-AT-083-N
requirements.text: Payoff-proven contract consistency: Enumerate permissible resolution/void/dispute states and quantities; exact/complement matching precedes worst-case net-payoff assessment.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-084-P; VAN-ML-AT-084-N
requirements.text: Non-atomic multi-venue risk and capital: Keep venue-specific balances, collateral/currency conversion and hedge-failure unwind costs; no instant cross-venue capital or fill assumption.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-085-P; VAN-ML-AT-085-N
requirements.text: Inventory-aware event quoting laboratory: Implement bounded quoting policies with event-family inventory, jump risk, adverse selection and value conditional on fills; no direct live execution.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-086-P; VAN-ML-AT-086-N
requirements.text: Maker quote lifecycle and protective withdrawal: Simulate pending/new/partial/cancel/unknown quote states, stale-feed reduction and scheduled-event withdrawal without manipulating markets.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-087-P; VAN-ML-AT-087-N
requirements.text: Four preregistered incremental-value studies: Implement risk-filter, surprise, volatility and ranking studies with identical opportunity sets, incumbent/calendar/exposure-matched controls and frozen utility.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-088-P; VAN-ML-AT-088-N
requirements.text: Prospective sealing and dependent uncertainty: Seal issued forecasts before outcomes, use event/time-block inference and full trial census; compare realistic lags and negative controls.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-089-P; VAN-ML-AT-089-N
requirements.text: Complete owner projections and operator controls: Extend existing event/research/work/evidence/settings and later native surfaces with source state, expectation lineage, study/lab controls, calibration and per-use outcomes.

requirements.acceptance: VAN-ML-AT-090-P; VAN-ML-AT-090-N
requirements.text: Failure isolation and truthful full-backend closure: Isolate event workers from T0 and finance; complete recovery, revocation and rollback; all new backend obligations feed existing gates without purchasing licences or fabricating access.

acceptance.adversarial: Remove DeepAR, a required challenger plugin or an event-research laboratory and attempt complete-backend admission; missing capability must be detected.
acceptance.positive: Exercise each required train/export/load/predict or event-laboratory operation through its real registered consumer; record a truthful rejected or inconclusive economic result when appropriate.
acceptance.recovery: Restore a previous model package without dropping any mandatory API or laboratory; stale economic permission remains inactive.

requirements.text: Preserve every inherited model, safe-artifact, calibration, lifecycle, probability, contract-replay, arbitrage and market-making research obligation. Economic influence is conditional; implementation is not made optional by a losing experiment.
requirements.title: Complete inherited forecasting and event-market engineering

acceptance.adversarial: Choose one account_service variant and silently discard a valid Jev, temperament, pending-order or lockout behavior; the preservation oracle fails.
acceptance.positive: Resolve each overlap using immutable source hashes, caller-level comparison and scoped positive regression evidence in an isolated worktree.
acceptance.recovery: If any advertised head changes, retain the prior inventory, invalidate affected source mappings and regenerate only the affected comparison before resuming.

requirements.text: Reconcile exact function/contract variants from PR101, canon/Jev/evidence, PR92, cognitive fabric and web-acquisition candidates. Preserve useful source changes without wholesale branch selection; refresh all advertised heads before application integration.
requirements.title: All-branch functional preservation and exact source identity

acceptance.adversarial: Submit a vendor capability or creator screenshot as E3 TEST_RECEIPT or E5 DEVICE_CERTIFIED; reject the claim.
acceptance.positive: Load known legacy categories with their original schema and retain separate source-quality and implementation states without promotion.
acceptance.recovery: After schema upgrade or rollback, replay original grades with their namespace and origin; unresolved legacy rows never acquire authority.

requirements.text: Use distinct research_source_class and implementation_evidence_level fields. Never translate source-class E3/E5 into a software-test or handset certificate. Legacy ambiguous grades require origin-schema evidence or remain unresolved.
requirements.title: Separate publication quality from implementation evidence

acceptance.adversarial: Inject a sign/sendTransaction, fund-wallet or broker-order request into a provider record or judgment; refuse and preserve the existing financial path.
acceptance.positive: Run a complete read-only discovery-to-evidence path and a concurrent existing risk-reducing exit without any additive financial operation.
acceptance.recovery: Restart or revoke the research service while an existing position is being protected; protection and reconciliation remain available.

requirements.text: The additive owns no wallet keys, signing RPC, venue order sender, position book or capital-allocation authority. No procurement, funded account or new trading permission is authorized. Existing mandatory exits cannot be vetoed by a research safety finding.
requirements.title: Read-only crypto research and single financial authority

acceptance.adversarial: Pass an uncalibrated fill estimate as an observed quote or subtract a fee already included in proceeds; detect both errors.
acceptance.positive: Reconcile a quoted entry, modeled exit/failure costs and aggregate edge without double-counting spread, impact, gas or transfer charges.
acceptance.recovery: Fee, model or quote-state changes invalidate affected assessments and reprice them with retained original versions.

requirements.text: Represent ExecutableQuoteFacts, ExecutionEconomicsForecast and NetEdgeAssessment as distinct linked records. Every cost carries cash unit, currency, side, size, as-of/available-at/expiry and fee-inclusion convention. Predictions also bind target, horizon, artifact, calibration and applicability.
requirements.title: Observed facts, modeled execution economics and net-edge separation

acceptance.adversarial: Scale nonlinear gas/slippage or a different entry/exit path by the actual trade R and call it realized performance; reject.
acceptance.positive: Show size-only attribution and independently simulated policy performance as separate, correctly labelled results.
acceptance.recovery: On a revised fill model recompute simulated results without editing actual venue receipts or historical size-only attribution.

requirements.text: Retain the current same-trade size-only shadow view with an explicit common-baseline-risk interpretation and proportional-assumption label. Distinct timing, selection, fees or liquidity require whole-policy replay, never scaled actual R.
requirements.title: Risk-unit and counterfactual interpretation

acceptance.adversarial: Use a terminal downside quantile as a calibrated stop-touch probability or pass future context into historical features; reject.
acceptance.positive: Fit and score each target against its correctly matured observations with non-overlapping training/validation availability.
acceptance.recovery: After target-policy revision, invalidate incompatible calibration and model use while preserving baseline operation.

requirements.text: Define terminal return, net strategy outcome, maximum adverse excursion, stop-touch and fill probability as different TargetSpec instances with distinct horizon, sampling, censoring and calibration contracts.
requirements.title: Distinct financial forecasting targets

acceptance.adversarial: Lowercase a case-sensitive address, confuse network identifiers, or treat a malformed address as valid; reject or quarantine.
acceptance.positive: Round-trip multiple address representations through the correct chain adapter and retain two different contracts with one display ticker.
acceptance.recovery: A codec version change triggers a reviewed migration preserving old aliases and links without merging distinct assets.

requirements.text: Normalize identifiers through discrete chain adapters and retain raw input. The canonical key includes chain namespace/network and decoded token address; ticker is display-only. Validate supported encoding/length without universal lowercasing.
requirements.title: Chain-specific canonical asset identity

acceptance.adversarial: Sum duplicated liquidity across routed hops or reassign an old quote to a new pool; reject the economics.
acceptance.positive: Track one asset across two pools and a migration with separate quote, liquidity and first-seen histories.
acceptance.recovery: Reorg or rollback of a migration invalidates affected route descendants and preserves original token identity.

requirements.text: Pools and routers have their own chain-qualified identities and state epochs. Multiple pools do not create different tokens; a pool migration creates an explicit versioned relationship, not a fabricated continuation of liquidity.
requirements.title: Independent pool/router identity and migrations

acceptance.adversarial: Treat Netcup/Oracle placement or unauthenticated reachability as unrestricted rights or funded trading eligibility; reject that inference.
acceptance.positive: Exercise a permitted provider contract and separately show a disabled/unavailable provider with a precise missing-evidence state.
acceptance.recovery: A permission expiry disables new affected acquisition and serving, preserves audit records according to applicable retention and leaves unrelated work runnable.

requirements.text: Record data-use scope, quotas, available history, retention, source timestamps and authentication requirements using permitted existing access. A public endpoint is not a rights grant. No purchase or account-creation task is added; fixtures never replace a missing real integration receipt.
requirements.title: Source capabilities and no-procurement access handling

acceptance.adversarial: Inject redirects to a private endpoint, oversized payload, malicious instructions, quota flood or an order-bearing method; refuse without expanding scope.
acceptance.positive: Capture and replay successful documented discovery/read calls with exact cursor, hash, latency and source availability.
acceptance.recovery: Resume from a durable cursor after outage and deduplicate retried source records without losing the observed cohort.

requirements.text: Use existing bounded acquisition infrastructure where compatible, with provider-specific quotas, retry/backoff, response limits, cursor checkpoints and immutable source observations. No private-session scraping or hidden execution API.
requirements.title: Bounded read-only acquisition and source provenance

acceptance.adversarial: Build training/test data only from survivors or delete a disappearing pool as missing data; fail cohort completeness.
acceptance.positive: Reconcile source discovery count with terminal and pending cohort states, including candidates never sent to a model.
acceptance.recovery: Rebuild the cohort projection from immutable discovery and decision events after a crash without hindsight re-ranking.

requirements.text: Seal every discovered candidate and its decision-time state before survival filters. Retain rejected, unknown, delisted, migrated, expired and unreachable cases with source/cursor lineage and retention policy.
requirements.title: Complete discovery cohort retention

acceptance.adversarial: Use string no as true, skip remaining checks for one survivor, or replace missing data with zero; reject.
acceptance.positive: One eligible survivor receives all remaining checks and can still end NO_TRADE; typed yes/no/unknown inputs give stable outcomes.
acceptance.recovery: A rule-version update rechecks affected candidates from retained facts and does not overwrite prior decisions.

requirements.text: Every candidate, including exactly one survivor, passes all applicable identity, security, uncertainty and economic gates. Normalize boolean-like inputs explicitly; never use string truthiness or unverified creator thresholds as defaults.
requirements.title: Ordered deterministic screening and typed unknowns

acceptance.adversarial: Keep a previous rejection forever after a changed authority, or requeue without bounds on each duplicate event; detect.
acceptance.positive: Recheck a changed security/route state immediately while leaving unchanged rejected candidates within their valid cooldown.
acceptance.recovery: Restart reconstructs queues and rejection expiry without duplicate jobs or lost source leases.

requirements.text: Negative-result caching binds reason, source version, state anchor, rule version and expiry. Recheck only on specified meaningful changes; bounded priority, starvation protection and quota budgeting are part of the same scheduler.
requirements.title: Cause-specific negative cache and deterministic rescreening

acceptance.adversarial: Treat an unparsed extension as harmless or a missing authority as proven revoked; refuse a clear verdict.
acceptance.positive: Evaluate versioned fixtures with revoked/active/unknown authorities, technical accounts and relevant extension combinations.
acceptance.recovery: After changed program/authority or source lag, invalidate affected security descendants and issue a fresh state-bound result.

requirements.text: Implement distinct SPL Token and Token-2022 read-only analysis for mint/freeze authority and applicable transfer fee, hook, delegate and extension capabilities. Unsupported or insufficiently observed extension/state stays UNKNOWN; include slot/finality and parser revision.
requirements.title: Solana-specific token capability analysis

acceptance.adversarial: Trust a verified proxy shell while ignoring its changed implementation or state-dependent sell restriction; detect.
acceptance.positive: Evaluate actual code/state fixtures for proxy upgrades, owner controls and transfer constraints with precise factual reasons.
acceptance.recovery: Implementation/code/state change invalidates dependent findings and simulations while retaining pre-change evidence.

requirements.text: Implement read-only EVM analysis for code/proxy/implementation identity, upgrade/admin privileges, transfer restrictions/taxes, mint/blacklist changes and liquidity-removal powers. Unverified source is uncertainty, not proof of fraud or safety.
requirements.title: EVM-specific contract capability analysis

acceptance.adversarial: Buy succeeds but sell reverts, transfers are taxed unexpectedly or simulation state is stale; no viable sellability assertion.
acceptance.positive: Produce separate state-bound buy/sell outcomes, executable quantities and explicit failure reasons for a reversible route.
acceptance.recovery: Changed router/contract/pool state invalidates the result and all affected economic descendants before any reuse.

requirements.text: Check buy and sell paths independently at the stated size and supported read-only simulation state. Record caller/context, assumptions, routing and finality. A buy quote or successful simulation never guarantees a future sell.
requirements.title: Independent state-bound sellability evidence

acceptance.adversarial: Linearly scale a small-size quote to exceed available depth or deduct included costs twice; fail.
acceptance.positive: Reconcile small and larger trade-size scenarios with observed route depth and the full fee convention.
acceptance.recovery: When a route disappears or fees change, revoke stale economics and produce a new unknown/refused readback.

requirements.text: Assess depth/impact across declared notionals and both legs; preserve denomination, rounding, minimums and nonlinear costs. Hypothetical exit costs remain modeled; missing depth is not infinite liquidity.
requirements.title: Executable liquidity and non-proportional costs

acceptance.adversarial: A reorg invalidates raw data but cached ForecastPacket or experiment still consumes it as current; reject.
acceptance.positive: Apply a controlled state replacement and enumerate every affected descendant; only revalidated descendants regain eligibility.
acceptance.recovery: Crash during invalidation resumes idempotently and cannot leave a partially invalidated result marked ready.

requirements.text: Bind every observation to block/slot/hash and finality policy. Reorganizations, source corrections and invalidated state must propagate to wallet features, sellability, model inputs, experiment versions and live-use eligibility without rewriting history.
requirements.title: Finality and transitive invalidation

acceptance.adversarial: Infer accumulation or holder growth from one snapshot or compare unequal source scopes without disclosure; abstain.
acceptance.positive: Compute changes across anchored snapshots while retaining the raw source series and coverage interval.
acceptance.recovery: A late/backfilled observation changes a new analytical version only; it does not appear in an earlier decision-time dataset.

requirements.text: Persist time-indexed holdings, supply, transfer, liquidity and role observations with source anchors and uncertainty. Flow and growth claims require comparable multiple observations, not one snapshot.
requirements.title: Temporal wallet and holder snapshots

acceptance.adversarial: Flag an AMM vault as an insider solely because it holds over a threshold or silently erase uncertain accounts; fail.
acceptance.positive: Explain raw and adjusted concentration with every role exclusion and uncertainty interval traceable to source evidence.
acceptance.recovery: Role reassignment triggers a versioned feature recomputation and reevaluation of affected decisions, not historical fact mutation.

requirements.text: Keep raw holder concentration alongside role-adjusted concentration. Exclude technical pool/router/vault/burn roles only with evidence, retain uncertain attribution and never equate a large account with beneficial insider ownership.
requirements.title: Attribution and raw-versus-adjusted concentration

acceptance.adversarial: Classify every transfer as a purchase or common funding as conclusive common ownership; reject the assertion.
acceptance.positive: Reconstruct a routed transfer and an actual buy without double-counting intermediate hops, retaining clustering assumptions.
acceptance.recovery: Replay updated decoders and labels under a new transform version, preserving the original episode references.

requirements.text: Deduplicate transaction/log/instruction identities; distinguish router hops, internal transfers, mint/burn, airdrops and independently evidenced buys/sells. Funding clusters and wash indicators remain uncertainty-bearing research features.
requirements.title: Transfer/flow deduplication and manipulation features

acceptance.adversarial: Divide by a fabricated previous volume or label an unobserved route exit as zero loss; fail.
acceptance.positive: Evaluate a newly discovered asset using only available history and return unknown for an unsupported growth/rate claim.
acceptance.recovery: As history matures, create a new eligible feature/label version without retroactively improving prior predictions.

requirements.text: Use explicit observation coverage for young assets and non-overlapping comparable windows. Incomplete lookbacks, unavailable routes and unobserved outcomes remain missing/censored with reason, not synthetic zero or impossible ratios.
requirements.title: Young-asset lookback and missingness semantics

acceptance.adversarial: Discard unavailable losing routes or count scam flags as guaranteed money saved; reject economic qualification.
acceptance.positive: Attach matured outcomes and publish unresolved counts with pessimistic/alternative sensitivity assumptions.
acceptance.recovery: Late outcomes produce auditable study revisions rather than changing sealed policy decisions.

requirements.text: Keep outcome resolution, censoring, delisting, disappearing liquidity and data availability explicit. Never call unresolved missingness a successful exit or exclude hard-to-price candidates from the denominator without a prespecified sensitivity study.
requirements.title: Outcome availability and cohort survival bias

acceptance.adversarial: Sum isolated profitable trades above account capital or reuse actual exits for a different entry/asset; reject.
acceptance.positive: Show the same cohort under two policies whose skipped trade changes later capital availability and compare complete net cash paths.
acceptance.recovery: Interrupted replay resumes from the exact arm checkpoint with stable hashes and no shared mutable state between arms.

requirements.text: Seal a shared decision-opportunity universe and independently replay each policy account, including different selections, delays, partial/no fills, reservations and opportunity cost. Counterfactual outcomes are SIMULATED_COUNTERFACTUAL, not observed or causal by assertion.
requirements.title: Matched opportunities and independent whole-account replay

acceptance.adversarial: Resample every snapshot as independent, peek repeatedly until significance or introduce a second conflicting threshold service; reject.
acceptance.positive: Evaluate clustered paired outcomes under a locked hypothesis and compare against exposure-matched/simple baselines with all trial costs.
acceptance.recovery: A policy amendment invalidates affected qualification claims while retaining all prior studies, including losing trials.

requirements.text: Extend the one validation policy with prespecified materiality, clustering, multiple trials, sample adequacy and stopping rules. Event/time/asset dependence must be respected; an optional lower-95%-bound policy is not an alternate gate or automatic live approval.
requirements.title: Dependent observations and one statistical admission policy

acceptance.adversarial: An external post requests orders, secrets or overriding a mandatory exit; no tool invocation or authority change occurs.
acceptance.positive: A real registered question set receives an anchored snapshot and returns a schema-valid answer/unknown with source and deadline lineage.
acceptance.recovery: On timeout/provider revocation the established deterministic baseline remains available and all pending judgments become expired/unknown.

requirements.text: Extend the existing dial-jev consumer, cognition contracts and exact evidence resolver with bounded registered questions. No second Jev service or credential plane; input/social content is untrusted evidence, never an instruction.
requirements.title: Reuse shared Jev for registered trading questions

acceptance.adversarial: Promote an answer-quality score or artifact hash as calibrated trade probability or independent corroboration of the same source; reject.
acceptance.positive: Compare no-LLM/rule, shared Jev and another approved challenger on identical sealed questions and independently observable outcomes, including cost and abstention.
acceptance.recovery: Question/model/input-policy revisions invalidate incompatible calibration and retain usable explanation-only fallback.

requirements.text: Answer quality, attribution uncertainty, event probability, trade outcome probability and ranking scores have different semantics. Only independently qualified domain outputs may enter their scoped consumer; Jev confidence is never a trade-win probability.
requirements.title: Judgment confidence and economic calibration remain distinct

acceptance.adversarial: Enable model-weighted ranking by merely selecting AllocatorV1, duplicate the allocator or use ranking to exceed portfolio reservations; reject.
acceptance.positive: Replay the inherited V0/V1 behavior unchanged, then separately test an admitted ranking-policy version with exact feature/forecast lineage.
acceptance.recovery: Revoke the ranking extension and restore the qualified baseline without releasing pending-order reservations or changing mandates.

requirements.text: Existing AllocatorV1 remains its observed deterministic non-confidence policy. Any model-informed ranking requires an explicitly versioned, qualified extension at the same owner; account coordination reserves capital and RiskAuthority sizes.
requirements.title: Versioned ranking extension without a second allocator

acceptance.adversarial: Synchronously call a chain indexer/model registry from T0 or label an expired/reorganized result ready; refuse.
acceptance.positive: Replay sealed outcomes exactly and test serving within its declared numeric tolerance, latency and applicability domain.
acceptance.recovery: A checkpoint/environment change triggers compatibility and tolerance tests; crash recovery preserves result identity and baseline availability.

requirements.text: T0 consumes only prepared bounded results; heavy research, public RPC and remote judges remain outside it. Distinguish persisted-output deterministic replay, fixed-environment inference tolerances and stochastic retraining; frozen data does not promise cross-device neural byte identity.
requirements.title: Bounded serving, expiry and honest determinism

acceptance.adversarial: A fixture-only feed appears LIVE, unresolved model appears profitable or read-only view enables a new order button; reject.
acceptance.positive: Read every stage through registered authenticated APIs and reconcile dashboard counts to underlying durable events.
acceptance.recovery: Outage/restart/revocation shows stale/unknown evidence and preserves complete read-only histories according to retention policy.

requirements.text: Expose truthful headless cohort, reasons, quote state, wallet uncertainty, judgments, experiment state and cost/health readbacks through existing capability/navigation owners. Enforce retention, quotas, recovery and provenance; implementation, access, economic and live-authority status are separate.
requirements.title: Complete operational and owner read-model integration

acceptance.adversarial: Open M8 UI after one feed, drop an inherited requirement, silently reuse changed packet numbers or self-issue a gate; reject.
acceptance.positive: Trace every additive obligation through producer, store, consumer, packet, tests, evidence and eventual owner surface; verify all required backends precede the sole BG.
acceptance.recovery: Scope changes regenerate signed-input candidates and invalidate affected downstream certificates while preserving all original artefacts and revision-qualified aliases.

requirements.text: Integrate A01-A08 and all review changes into one generated parent plan. Map former M/G identifiers as versioned aliases, retain all old requirements/actions/corrections and add read-only contexts only after global BG-001. Scope approval is not F15, provider access or financial permission.
requirements.title: Single amended scope, backend barrier and complete traceability

requirements.acceptance: Actual outcome producer, durable evidence, selector and evolution consumers form one integrated VATI loop.
requirements.text: Self-optimization is an end-to-end required backend outcome

requirements.acceptance: Operational choices are automatic under qualified grants; novel policies require independent qualification and authorized promotion.
requirements.text: Two autonomy levels with separate financial activation

requirements.acceptance: Evidence update, operational selection and policy mutation are three different typed effects.
requirements.text: Narrow extension of LearningBoundary without removing forbidden policy targets

requirements.acceptance: Bind policy/artifact/qualification/venue/account/product/expiry and tested joint parameters to existing mandate.
requirements.text: Exact operational grant and joint parameter domain

requirements.acceptance: Filter authorization, venue capability, order semantics, data, urgency, deadline and protection before scoring.
requirements.text: Feasibility filtering is irrevocable within a selection

requirements.acceptance: Empty urgent-compatible candidates choose explicit emergency route or refusal appropriate to objective purpose.
requirements.text: Urgency cannot fall back to the original ineligible score set

requirements.acceptance: Registry insertion order never decides fallback; decision binds immutable chosen semantics.
requirements.text: Stable fallback and template-epoch binding

requirements.acceptance: Do not call a mixture of medians an expectation or missing cost zero; record units, estimator and uncertainty.
requirements.text: Execution estimator matches its mathematical target

requirements.acceptance: Version canonical bucket key, product, side, amount/participation, fees, volatility, event and regime.
requirements.text: Context includes economically meaningful size and liquidity

requirements.acceptance: Order finality, cash/fee finality and markout maturity are separate; child messages are not independent trades.
requirements.text: Maturity, censoring and parent-level sample meaning

requirements.acceptance: Live/demo/paper/shadow/backtest/counterfactual provenance stays separate and source-authorized.
requirements.text: Environment and source evidence cannot be promoted by relabeling

requirements.acceptance: Account coordinator owns total worst-case exposure, including uncertain and cancel-pending children.
requirements.text: Parent and all potential child exposure share one reservation

requirements.acceptance: Exact command and causal/fence identity committed before side effect; no exactly-once network assumption.
requirements.text: Durable command before transport and broker-aware idempotency

requirements.acceptance: Cancel request does not release exposure; all feasible interleavings join authoritative facts.
requirements.text: Cancellation/fill and expiry races remain economically truthful

requirements.acceptance: Distinguish atomic amend, cancel-replace, identity/priority change and unsupported operations.
requirements.text: Amend/replace capabilities and queue priority are explicit

requirements.acceptance: Immediate and pending fills share confirmed-protection/recovery behavior; flatten request is not flatness.
requirements.text: Per-fill protection and uncertain emergency close

requirements.acceptance: Use approved deadline/TIF; adapter defaults and restarts cannot extend it.
requirements.text: Approved lifetime reaches every child and recovery layer

requirements.acceptance: Preserve requested order type and side-correct limit; touching does not imply unlimited fills.
requirements.text: Correct limit, stop and conditional economic semantics

requirements.acceptance: Authoritative fill identity, correction/bust and fee currency feed one cash/position state.
requirements.text: Fill revisions, partial fees and cumulative quantity accounting

requirements.acceptance: Verified anchor plus tail reduces repeated work without accepting tampered history.
requirements.text: Integrity-preserving ledger checkpoints and bounded hot path

requirements.acceptance: Register actual outcome consumer, persist update and prove later decision effect.
requirements.text: Real observe-to-select production binding

requirements.acceptance: Observation contribution, consumed revision and cursor/snapshot publish atomically.
requirements.text: Immutable evidence snapshots and atomic cursor advancement

requirements.acceptance: No retroactive editing of issued decision; affected future statistics/models are invalidated or restated.
requirements.text: Evidence corrections preserve as-decided and restated views

requirements.acceptance: Use only fresh mature compatible evidence; pooling/fallback is versioned and justified.
requirements.text: Freshness/OOD and hierarchical fallback have qualified semantics

requirements.acceptance: Qualified hysteresis, tie tolerance, persistence and joint action envelope constrain parameter changes.
requirements.text: Bounded operational switching and stability

requirements.acceptance: Remote interpretation/training stays off decision/protection path; bounded queues and credentials.
requirements.text: Research/LLM noninterference and resource isolation

requirements.acceptance: Weekly/drift jobs register target/comparator/budget and every attempted or cancelled candidate.
requirements.text: Complete triggers, hypotheses and all-trial census

requirements.acceptance: Price/time/cost/account oracle and causal tests are prerequisites to candidate efficacy.
requirements.text: Evaluator qualification before policy optimization

requirements.acceptance: Fit/selection/calibration/test records reflect actual chronology, with overlap controls.
requirements.text: Real walk-forward folds and protected holdout

requirements.acceptance: Mutating later information cannot affect earlier features, decisions or commands.
requirements.text: Prefix causality and future-data poison diagnostics

requirements.acceptance: Each arm has its own cash/reservations/holdings while receiving same permissible information and resource limits.
requirements.text: Matched policy and full-account feasibility comparison

requirements.acceptance: No live randomized exploration by default; off-policy claims require propensity/overlap assumptions.
requirements.text: Causal support and separately authorized exploration

requirements.acceptance: Qualification binds exact cohort/evaluator/artifact, uncertainty and operational limits; author cannot self-certify.
requirements.text: Independent economic qualification and prospective evidence

requirements.acceptance: New bindings require qualified and authenticated promotion; open parents retain policy unless explicit compatible migration.
requirements.text: Atomic authorized activation and active-parent version pinning

requirements.acceptance: Safety response immediate; economic monitoring uses qualified windows/sequential method; rollback never restores account history.
requirements.text: Monitoring, suspension and compatible rollback

requirements.acceptance: Frozen benchmark/horizon includes partial/non-fill costs and explicit fees without double counting.
requirements.text: Objective-level cost and anti-reward-hacking

requirements.acceptance: Full positive loop is mandatory; real candidate may correctly fail economic tests.
requirements.text: Positive mechanism demonstration distinct from economic promise

requirements.acceptance: Expose active binding, changed decision, evidence/maturity, authority and fallback without ungrounded profit claims.
requirements.text: Owner-visible adaptive state with exact causal trace

requirements.acceptance: Learned state can evolve under qualified rule; rule/action/reward/scope changes use policy evolution; risk changes keep own authority.
requirements.text: Operational vs learned policy versus strategy/risk change

requirements.acceptance: Target delta accounts for actual holdings/working orders, netting mode and manual/strategy ownership.
requirements.text: Portfolio targets respect ownership and pending exposure

requirements.acceptance: Immediate/passive/chase/TWAP/participation/target methods have positive supported paths and constrained unsupported refusal.
requirements.text: Algorithm family complete with capability refusal not coercion

requirements.acceptance: Required forecasting plugins are complete integrations, while active selection uses qualified minimal stack.
requirements.text: Model breadth preserved with evidence-gated economic use

requirements.acceptance: DesignChangeProposal binds source/data/evaluator/alternatives/uncertainty, complexity effects and affected contracts.
requirements.text: Astra design changes grounded in valid backtests and ablation

requirements.acceptance: Every new lifecycle/crypto operation has producer, caller, tests and scoped evidence before frontend.
requirements.text: Whole-backend gate includes both autonomy levels

requirements.acceptance: At least one eligible supported CEX spot integration; same risk/router/lifecycle owners and current markets preserved.
requirements.text: Actual spot crypto trading through VATI across manual and automatic objectives

requirements.acceptance: API family, account/subaccount, native product, spot type, base/quote/network identities are versioned.
requirements.text: Exact exchange/product and asset identity

requirements.acceptance: Tick/step/min-notional/max limits and fee reserves apply before exact risk approval.
requirements.text: Venue filters, precision and executable quantity

requirements.acceptance: Trading workers lack withdrawal scope; secret references and account grants remain per environment.
requirements.text: Trade credentials separated from funding and withdrawals

requirements.acceptance: Buy reserves quote, sell owned base; fees/base/quote/third assets and cash conversion explicit; no leverage.
requirements.text: Spot inventory, stablecoin valuation and actual fee currencies

requirements.acceptance: Sequence/checksum, timestamps, snapshot boundaries, fill IDs and resync per selected provider.
requirements.text: Snapshot/delta books and private-stream recovery

requirements.acceptance: No silent coercion, native/synthetic stop distinction, amend priority and trigger sources explicit.
requirements.text: Crypto limit/post-only/stop/amend behavior is capability qualified

requirements.acceptance: 24/7 operation still handles maintenance; nonce/clock constraints; cancel/query headroom protected.
requirements.text: Rate-limit, clock and outage budget preserves recovery priority

requirements.acceptance: Account-wide cancellation must be assessed against protective/manual orders; no automatic blanket enabling.
requirements.text: Dead-man switch scope cannot silently remove protection

requirements.acceptance: Provider chosen by eligible current access; mocked Coinbase Advanced output cannot qualify matching or latency.
requirements.text: Real integration evidence distinct from static API sandbox

requirements.acceptance: Crypto full-account arms include correct data conventions, fees, liquidity drought, maintenance, delisting and stablecoin stress.
requirements.text: Crypto evaluator has event-time, depth, costs and stress realism

requirements.acceptance: Chain discovery remains read-only; only independently admitted exchange products may enter actual order universe.
requirements.text: Research-only chain data never becomes an order or wallet signer

requirements.acceptance: Spot support does not imply margin/perps/options/DEX/withdraw authority; any extension needs product-specific qualification.
requirements.text: Derivatives and live activation are explicit separate boundaries

requirements.acceptance: Markets/accounts/order/positions/news/learning show genuine venue and assets, permissions, fee/protection/recovery states.
requirements.text: Crypto frontend is full existing-context integration after BG

requirements.acceptance: Extend existing boundaries; justify any new process/store with measured isolation/correctness benefit.
requirements.text: No mandatory new deployable services or competing truth stores

requirements.acceptance: Each candidate lists operational cost, maintenance/state burden, alternatives and incremental evidence; safety complexity is mandatory.
requirements.text: Complexity ledger and ablation of speculative additions

requirements.acceptance: All inherited requirement/action/context objects remain, with explicit semantic additions not automatic deletion.
requirements.text: No requirement loss disguised as simplicity

requirements.acceptance: Internal optimizer states become contextual typed views; no new default global tab or dense Home.
requirements.text: Complete API contract and life-cycle read models, not dashboard sprawl

requirements.acceptance: Astra proposals bind experimental evidence and causal claims; result classes and amendment path explicit.
requirements.text: Backtest can improve design but cannot issue authority

requirements.acceptance: All new capabilities feed sole BG and existing context/material contracts; no early native renderer.
requirements.text: Preserve both locked themes and backend-first whole-product completion

requirements.acceptance: Lose cancel reply; authenticated lookup proves cancelled with partial fills; record fills once, retain protection and release only proven unused reservation. A timeout, absent REST result or expired local timer never proves cancellation or flat exposure. Restart at cancel-send and query boundaries, then accept late fill/correction without resubmission.
requirements.text: Complete unknown-order, cancellation and expiry recovery

requirements.acceptance: Dispatch resolves current qualified policy, mandate, reservation, epoch and objective; positive decimal venue increments and complete mature costs validate. Remove only POLICY_QUALIFIED at dispatch and reseal unsigned locks; named semantic check still fails. Reject zero tick and mature unknown costs. Expiry/revocation at any preactivation or drain stage blocks new risk, reconciles in-flight effects and cannot reactivate revoked fallback.
requirements.text: Semantic admission independent of mutable hash locks

requirements.acceptance: Real registered consumer applies newer observation revision once, persists cursor/contribution/snapshot atomically, and later eligible selector consumes its fingerprint. Deliver older revision after correction and conflicting equal revision; older evidence cannot overwrite current contribution and conflict is quarantined. Kill actual process before/after commit, replay bounded journal and verify identical logical snapshot/selection with AS_DECIDED unchanged.
requirements.text: Revision precedence and durable causal feedback

requirements.acceptance: One gross base unit filled with 0.01 base fee consumes the entire one-unit execution budget; cash/base/fee-asset postings balance under explicit valuation. Fees, exits or netting cannot reopen entry allowance; TCA decomposition must equal direct signed fill-versus-reference cost plus nonembedded charges. Late fee and fill bust append compensating facts, preserve old decision snapshots and reconcile reservations without automatic re-entry.
requirements.text: Gross execution budget and conserved multi-asset economics

requirements.acceptance: Quantized slices jointly satisfy parent quantity, fresh depth participation, minimum lot/notional, maximum slices, deadline and command budget. Quantity 200, depth 10, participation 0.25 and max 8 slices is infeasible for a one-snapshot plan; never issue eight slices of 25 claiming a cap of 2.5. Replanning uses newly observed depth/time under same grant; restart retains lifetime counters and does not repeat unconfirmed slices.
requirements.text: Joint slice, participation and lifetime feasibility

requirements.acceptance: Reconcile Opus lockout/execution/ledger fixes with canon Jev/temperament/evidence, PR-only Muse/owner controls and their callers; full parity holds. Selecting newer review-input source or main alone must fail retained-feature/caller tests; deleting actual outcome subscription fails later-selection acceptance. Shared-store migrations restore learned state, lockout clocks and account owners; asynchronous Jev outage cannot delay protection.
requirements.text: Preserve source contributions and verify actual feedback consumers

requirements.acceptance: Qualified event oracle, immutable licensed inputs, full trial census and availability-time features support matched objective and whole-account arms with predeclared costs and uncertainty. Calendar years alone are not walk-forward; bid data cannot silently become mid; poisoned-future changes to earlier decisions fail; fixed JPY conversion is not current USD P&L. Failed/pruned runs and corrections remain in census; evaluator changes invalidate dependent claims and rerun only affected studies.
requirements.text: Qualified evaluator and complete trial/account comparison

requirements.acceptance: Selected eligible CEX spot adapter demonstrates genuine matching, recovery and settlement/protection for its admitted scope; contextual app contracts expose exact state and receipts. Mock, read-only HTTP response, chain research or unsupported required attached protection cannot close actual trading integration. Private-stream gaps, API clock/rate-limit stress and account-wide cancellation recover without cancelling manual/protective orders outside scope; unavailable provider remains an explicit gate.
